#!/bin/bash
# System Maintenance Script
# This script performs routine maintenance tasks

echo "Starting system maintenance..."

# Task 1: Clean temporary files
echo "Cleaning temporary files..."
find /tmp -type f -mtime +7 -delete
find /var/tmp -type f -mtime +30 -delete

# Task 2: Update system logs
echo "Rotating logs..."
logrotate /etc/logrotate.conf

# Task 3: Check disk usage
echo "Checking disk usage..."
df -h | awk '$5 > "80%" {print "WARNING: " $6 " is at " $5 " capacity"}'

# Task 4: Backup configuration files
echo "Backing up configs..."
tar -czf /backup/configs_$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz /etc/*.conf

# Task 5: Restart services if needed
echo "Checking services..."
for service in nginx mysql redis; do
    if ! systemctl is-active --quiet $service; then
        echo "Restarting $service..."
        systemctl restart $service
    fi
done

echo "Maintenance complete!"
